Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Cairo, Egypt.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passportYES Regular biometric passportYESService/Official biometric passportYES Diplomatic biometric passportYES
Citizens of the Republic of Ghana are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Cairo, Egypt.
